activity.notes: Oxford Bibliographies identifies Zhukov's emergence as a leading general at Khalkhin-Gol in August 1939 and follows his senior wartime commands through the capture of Berlin and his signing of Germany's unconditional surrender in May 1945. ATLAS therefore uses 1939-1945 as a bounded representative high-command military-activity rail rather than his full military career or lifespan.

sources.title: Georgii Zhukov — Oxford Bibliographies in Military History
sources.citation_text: Geoffrey Roberts traces Zhukov from his 1939 Khalkhin-Gol command through his decisive Second World War high commands and the German surrender in May 1945.
